title: Personalizing LLM Agent Memory Using Biometrics
abstract: arXiv:2609.08558v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Personalized memory helps LLM agents deliver stable, tailored assistance by storing and reusing user-specific data across interactions. In multi-user scenarios, however, retrieval must consider not only semantic similarity but also whether the current requester matches the identity associated with the stored memory. We propose Bio-Memory, a biometric-aware memory architecture that conditions memory retrieval on both semantic similarity and biometric matching. Built on top of A-Mem, Bio-Memory augments each atomic memory note with a biometric embedding and uses biometric matching to form the retrieval candidate pool before semantic ranking. We evaluate Bio-Memory on LoCoMo in a 10-user shared-agent setting over 7 face benchmarks and 10 palmprint protocols. Across datasets, Bio-Memory consistently separates owner and non-owner queries. Under face-based personalization, the largest average gap reaches 27.29% / 21.15% in F1 / BLEU-1 on CALFW

translated_title: 使用生物特征技术实现LLM智能体记忆的个性化
translated_abstract: 个性化记忆通过在交互过程中存储和复用用户特定的数据，帮助LLM智能体提供稳定且量身定制的辅助。然而，在多用户场景中，记忆检索不仅需要考虑语义相似性，还需要判断当前请求者是否与存储记忆相关联的身份相匹配。我们提出了Bio-Memory，一种生物特征感知的记忆架构，它将记忆检索同时条件化于语义相似性和生物特征匹配。Bio-Memory构建在A-Mem之上，为每个原子记忆笔记添加了生物特征嵌入，并在语义排序之前使用生物特征匹配来形成检索候选池。我们在LoCoMo数据集上，以10用户共享智能体的设置，通过7个人脸基准和10个掌纹协议对Bio-Memory进行了评估。在各个数据集上，Bio-Memory均能稳定地区分记忆所有者和非所有者的查询。在基于人脸的个性化设置下，在CALFW数据集上F1/BLEU-1的最大平均差距达到27.29%/21.15%。
tldr: 提出Bio-Memory架构，通过将生物特征匹配与语义相似性相结合来个性化LLM智能体的记忆检索，在多用户场景中能有效区分记忆所有者与非所有者。
en_tdlr: Bio-Memory, a biometric-aware memory architecture that combines biometric matching with semantic similarity to personalize LLM agent memory retrieval, effectively separating memory owners from non-owners in multi-user scenarios.
